Worked great for a Whirlpool Duet Sport dryer I bought in 2007 - Simple to install. On the inside of the door on a Duet Sport you'll see 3 kinds of screws - one is Torx ('star' bit) and the other 2 are Phillips heads that are different sizes. Remove the 6 smaller ones - one 12 o'clock, two each at 3 and 9 o'clock, one at 6 o'clock. Do yourself a favor and remove the top one last. I use some diagonal cutters to cut the old one so it could come out. press the new one in. Reinstall the screws starting with the top one - leave them loose until all the screws are in. Give the front a jiggle and it will self-align. Tighten the screws - they don't have to be super tight, just snug. Done.

Even though the clips have different colors on the metal 'spring' it looks like they'll all work. Also, I didn't realize it until i worked on it that the door has a latch on each side and ONLY ONE IS USED TO LATCH THE DOOR on the Duet Sport. i could have just used the other to replace the broken one.

Compare old element to provided picture. - Before you order your replacement element turn off the power (I turned off the 50 amp breaker in the breaker box) and remove old element so you can see the type of connections. Even though you have a correct cross over number for the element it might not be the same. Compare your element with the provided pictures making sure they look alike. In my case the connecting terminals were spay (slide on) and the element had a bend which matched the provided picture. It takes a ¼ nut driver to loosen to two machine screws from the mount. Needle nose or diagonal side cutters to remove the wires. Tip the front of the element up and pull back and the element comes out showing the connecting wires. Very carefully remove wires from each side and re attach to the new the element and reverse the take out step and re install. After mount screws are secure reset your power. Test and preheat the oven. It took less than a half an hour to complete the install. Excellent Value, Great Price. Shipping was on time.
